## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] Feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the [Moodle coding style](https://moodledev.io/general/development/policies/codingstyle).
- [ ] All identifiers, comments and commit messages are in English.
- [ ] Lang strings (if added) are alphabetically sorted in `lang/en/local_oksigeniaaccess.php` and `lang/es/local_oksigeniaaccess.php`.
- [ ] No Personal data is collected on the server side (or the Privacy provider is updated accordingly).
- [ ] `moodle-plugin-ci` passes locally (or I trust GitHub Actions to confirm).
- [ ] If the bundled web component (`js/web-component.js`) changed, the upstream PR in [`OksigeniaSL/oksigenia-web-libs`](https://github.com/OksigeniaSL/oksigenia-web-libs) was merged and published first.
